caption: The video captures a wide landscape at sunset, with an orange sky and a bright sun glow partly hidden behind a dark, snow-flecked mountain ridge. A thick, undulating sea of low clouds fills the valley below the ridge, its rippled surface shifting almost imperceptibly. In the near foreground, dark silhouetted leafless bushes sit at the bottom-left, while a thin fence line runs along the very bottom edge. The overall composition, lighting and color balance remain essentially constant. The dark cloud band crossing the sun glow shows little visible change. No object visibly enters or exits the scene, while the foreground bushes and fence remain in place. The framing appears largely fixed, with no obvious pan, tilt, zoom or translation. The mountain ridge and the protruding dark hill on the right hold their positions.
